title: Formally unramified morphism of schemes (at most one infinitesimal lift)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The morphism $f$ is *formally unramified* if for every first order thickening $T\subset T'$ of affine schemes over $S$ [def-sbc-first-order-thickening] (so $T'$ is an affine scheme with a given morphism $b:T'\to S$, $i:T\to T'$ is the closed immersion with square-zero ideal sheaf, and $T$ is a scheme over $S$ through $b\circ i$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]) and every morphism $a:T\to X$ over $S$ (i.e. $f\circ a=b\circ i$) there is at most one morphism $a':T'\to X$ over $S$ (i.e. $f\circ a'=b$) with $a'\circ i=a$.
